title: Innovation Exemption
scope: Tokenized NMS stocks on qualifying Tokenized Securities Venues; certain liquidity providers
key_conditions: Permissioned AMM/liquidity-pool venues; symbol/volume limits; tokenized NMS stock must provide the same rights and privileges as equivalent traditional NMS stock; unaffiliated third-party tokenization requires issuer notice and opportunity to object; smart contracts must be auditable, public, and deployed on a public permissionless ledger; token trading must halt with the underlying primary-market halt; public operational/trading disclosures required
